The storefront is bright yellow with many snack packages visible on shelves behind them. The women are smiling and gesturing while talking. (2) A brief jump cut shows a close-up of a male's face from a photo or screen, followed by a return to the street scene. The group of women has changed; now there are four young women holding large white shopping bags, standing on a sidewalk with urban buildings in the background. (3) The scene shifts to another interview where the woman in grey talks to two young Western women, one with long curly hair and another wearing a baseball cap. They are standing near a shop window. (4) The camera pans to a man inside the store wearing a black t-shirt, who is being interviewed while holding a large white bag of 'Milk Classic' snacks. (5) A final montage shows several red plastic shopping baskets filled with various snack boxes and bags being stacked on top of each other on the ground.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy, upbeat synth-pop BGM starts. A bright female voice speaks in Mandarin with an excited tone, introducing the street interview. Ambient sounds of a busy Seoul street are audible. (2) A 'pop' SFX triggers as text appears. Multiple female voices laugh and overlap as they discuss their frequent trips to Korea. (3) The BGM continues as the interviewer switches between English and Mandarin. A cartoonish 'slide whistle' or 'boing' sound effect plays when a funny realization occurs. (4) Sound of plastic crinkling is heard as interviewees handle shopping bags. The male voice is calmer and deeper but still friendly. (5) Fast-paced editing with frequent 'ding' SFX emphasizing the food items mentioned. BGM maintains a consistent, joyful rhythm until the end.
